panels.title: Latest reference month
panels.description: Most recent reference month with a published rate in the range. SGS 25464 is published with a lag of one to two months.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT strftime(max(ref_dt), '%Y-%m') AS month
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_personal_loan_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Latest monthly rate
panels.description: Average monthly interest rate on non-payroll personal loans to individuals (free resources) in the latest month in range (SGS 25464, % per month).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT arg_max(value, ref_dt)::DOUBLE AS rate
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_personal_loan_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Annualized equivalent
panels.description: Latest monthly rate compounded over 12 months: ((1 + rate)^12 - 1), % per year.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT arg_max(annualized_value, ref_dt)::DOUBLE AS annualized
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_personal_loan_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Change vs previous month
panels.description: Latest monthly rate minus the previous month's rate, in percentage points. Looks back before the range start when needed.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_personal_loan_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ref_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
l AS (
  SELECT max(ref_dt) AS last_dt
  FROM d
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT (c.value - p.value)::DOUBLE AS change_pp
FROM l
JOIN d c ON c.ref_dt = l.last_dt
JOIN d p ON p.ref_dt = (l.last_dt - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)::DATE

panels.title: Change vs 12 months earlier
panels.description: Latest monthly rate minus the rate of the same month one year earlier, in percentage points. Looks back before the range start when needed.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_personal_loan_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ref_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
l AS (
  SELECT max(ref_dt) AS last_dt
  FROM d
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT (c.value - p.value)::DOUBLE AS change_12m_pp
FROM l
JOIN d c ON c.ref_dt = l.last_dt
JOIN d p ON p.ref_dt = (l.last_dt - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE

panels.title: Range min / max
panels.description: Lowest and highest monthly rate in the range (% per month).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  min(value)::DOUBLE AS "Min",
  max(value)::DOUBLE AS "Max"
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_personal_loan_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Monthly rate and annualized equivalent
panels.description: Average monthly rate on non-payroll personal loans (% per month, left axis) and its 12-month compounded equivalent (% per year, right axis), by reference month.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ref_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  value::DOUBLE AS "Monthly rate",
  annualized_value::DOUBLE AS "Annualized"
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_personal_loan_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Month-over-month change
panels.description: Monthly rate minus the previous month's rate, in percentage points; red bars are increases, green bars decreases.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_personal_loan_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ref_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 1 MONTH
    AND ref_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
)
SELECT
  c.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  (c.value - p.value)::DOUBLE AS "Change vs previous month"
FROM d c
JOIN d p ON p.ref_dt = (c.ref_dt - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)::DATE
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Change vs 12 months earlier
panels.description: Monthly rate minus the rate of the same month one year earlier, in percentage points.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_personal_loan_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ref_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 12 MONTH
    AND ref_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
)
SELECT
  c.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  (c.value - p.value)::DOUBLE AS "Change vs 12 months earlier"
FROM d c
JOIN d p ON p.ref_dt = (c.ref_dt - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Yearly summary
panels.description: Per calendar year, over the months in range: average monthly rate, average annualized equivalent, and the lowest and highest monthly rate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  year(ref_dt)::VARCHAR AS year,
  count(*) AS months,
  avg(value)::DOUBLE AS avg_monthly,
  avg(annualized_value)::DOUBLE AS avg_annualized,
  min(value)::DOUBLE AS min_monthly,
  max(value)::DOUBLE AS max_monthly
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_personal_loan_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY year DESC

panels.title: Monthly detail
panels.description: Every reference month in range: monthly rate, annualized equivalent, changes vs the previous month and vs 12 months earlier (percentage points), and the SGS blocked flag.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value, annualized_value, blocked
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_personal_loan_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ref_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 12 MONTH
    AND ref_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
)
SELECT
  strftime(c.ref_dt, '%Y-%m') AS month,
  c.value::DOUBLE AS rate,
  c.annualized_value::DOUBLE AS annualized,
  (c.value - m.value)::DOUBLE AS change_1m_pp,
  (c.value - y.value)::DOUBLE AS change_12m_pp,
  c.blocked
FROM d c
LEFT JOIN d m ON m.ref_dt = (c.ref_dt - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)::DATE
LEFT JOIN d y ON y.ref_dt = (c.ref_dt - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE
WHERE $__timeFilter(c.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY c.ref_dt DESC
